name: nextmail/sdk
description: The official PHP SDK for the Nextmail API. Send email and broadcasts, work with threads, drafts, labels, templates, rules, webhooks, tracking, contacts, audiences, sign-up forms, domains, suppressions, files, API keys, roles, members, mailbox imports and disposable inboxes from PHP.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Send the SDK's requests through Guzzle, wrapped in Nextmail\Http\Psr18HttpClient.
suggest.symfony/http-client: Send the SDK's requests through Symfony HttpClient's Psr18Client, wrapped in Nextmail\Http\Psr18HttpClient. Also install psr/http-client and nyholm/psr7.
suggest.php-http/discovery: Finds an installed PSR-17 implementation for Nextmail\Http\Psr18HttpClient when you do not pass the factories yourself.
suggest.ext-mbstring: Lets Nextmail::resolveLanguage() match a language name written in capitals outside ASCII, such as ESPAÑOL.
